Mathématicien et physicien français. En: French mathematician and physicist. In 1837, in his Research on the Probability of Judgments, he named the “law of large numbers”.
Éditeur anglais né à Kendal. Sa Cyclopae: English publisher born in Kendal. His Cyclopaedia, published in London in 1728, was only meant to be translated into French: it became Diderot and d'Alembert's Encyclopédie.
Économiste autrichien, naturalisé britan: Austrian economist, British citizen from 1938, Nobel prize in economics in 1974. In 1945, “The Use of Knowledge in Society” showed that prices gather knowledge scattered among everyone.
Joueur d'échecs né à Bakou, champion du: Chess player born in Baku, world champion from 1985 to 2000. In 1999, he beat more than 50,000 players united as the World Team, in 62 moves.
